artworks.title: Horse with Soldiers Smoking Pipe/Military Scene
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on grey/green paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14.6 x 16.8 cm (5 3/4 x 6 5/8 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection, gift in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses and figures in a rustic setting. The artwork shows several horses equipped with riding gear, standing alongside figures wearing long coats and top hats near a wagon. The foreground horse is adorned with a blanket and saddle, showcasing detailed craftsmanship in fabric textures and the horse's anatomy. The drawing includes a rustic landscape with farm carts, wooden wheels, and a few individuals seemingly engaged in casual activity. The sky is lightly shaded with distant birds. The characters wear attire hinting at a historical period, possibly suggesting travel or a rural life setting. The intricate line work and shading create depth and texture, capturing the diverse elements within the scene.

artworks.title: The Neighing Horse
artworks.medium: color etching inked à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse standing on a patch of ground. The horse is illustrated with detailed fine lines that emphasize the texture of its coat and the flowing mane that drapes over its neck. The horse stands in a proud pose, with its head turned slightly to one side. Its mouth is open slightly revealing strokes of color near the muzzle. The hooves are shown prominently, anchoring the creature to the ground. The surrounding area is subtly rendered to suggest grass and earth.

artworks.title: Pissing Cow and Two Sheep
artworks.medium: color etching inked à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cow and two sheep. The drawing depicts a standing cow in the foreground, characterized by prominent horns and udders, with its body rendered in fine detail. The cow appears to be in a relaxed posture, weight balanced on its legs. Next to the cow, a sheep is lying down, with another sheep standing beside it. The drawing uses fine dots and shading to create depth. It has a monochromatic palette of earthy tones.

artworks.title: The Cowherd
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a group of cows near a body of water. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down at the scene. The horizon is at the top of the image, above a narrow strip of land in the distance. Closest to the viewer, a cow stands on a small hill with another cow lying next to it among foliage. More cows are gathered further away, slightly elevated, with some sparse trees. Faint buildings or structures can be seen on the horizon by the water. The etching technique is detailed, with fine lines used to create texture on the cows and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and sepia. Birds are visible in the sky above the horizon.

artworks.title: Meal Time
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman, a child, and two men seated, with one person standing. The woman is centrally positioned, wearing a headscarf and a cloak over a dress. An older man is seated to her right, while a child is on her left. Behind them stands an individual with a large hat and cloak. Another person on the right appears to be kneeling, shirtless with tattered pants. Items are on the ground near them. The background shows a rural landscape with a river, trees, and a horizon.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man and animals in a rustic setting. The image features a seated figure outdoors with rocky terrain. Nearby, animals including a sow and piglets gather. In the background, a structure is visible on a hillside against the sky. The drawing uses shading to create depth and texture, conveying a sense of tranquility and simplicity.

artworks.title: Tinkers
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an outdoor setting. On the left, two people are seated at the base of a large tree. The first person, an older man, is visible from the waist upwards with some facial hair and a hat. His right arm is outstretched. Beside him, a woman with a headscarf sits, looking up at the man. On the right, a young man stands in profile with short hair and layered clothing. He holds objects and has pots and pans tied around his neck. The background features trees and countryside, with loose objects in the foreground.

artworks.title: Potato Lifting
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: A drawing of two figures walking alongside a fence with trees in the background. The figures are barefoot and carrying burdens on their shoulders as they walk on a path bordered by rustic elements. The scene includes distant figures bending towards the ground, possibly engaged in agricultural labor. The foreground captures the detail of the figures' expressions and attire. The style suggests meticulous line work and shading common in 19th-century etching.

artworks.title: An Alpine Valley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David and Elizabeth Tunick in honor of Earl A. Powell III's Tenth Anniversary as Director of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This image shows an aerial view of a mountainous landscape. The horizon is high, dividing the sky from the mountains below. The mountains have rocky peaks with some snow, and there is a green valley with small buildings. The cliffs and valleys lead towards a mountain range in the distance. The painting has detailed brushstrokes showing the rocks and foliage. The colors are mostly earthy tones with blue sky and white snow.

artworks.title: Panorama on a Mountain Lake
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawn from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the image, with mountain ranges depicted with light pencil lines. Closest to us, there is textured foliage and shrubbery created with darker shading and strokes. A small village is visible with a spire among the buildings. The style of the brushstrokes is soft and methodical, with cross-hatching and shading for depth. The image is in shades of brown and gray.

artworks.title: The Combat of the Horatii and the Curatii
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Jean-Jacques-François Le Barbier I
artworks.medium: wash manner, printed in blue, red, and black inks
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 39 x 49.4 cm (15 3/8 x 19 7/16 in.)
overall (outer framing line): 32.9 x 44.2 cm (12 15/16 x 17 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips, in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This is a painting of a battle scene with divine intervention. Soldiers are fighting in the center foreground. A divine figure levitates above the battlefield, holding a branch. In the background, soldiers stand in formation with raised spears and trees frame the scenery. The color palette consists of pale blues, earthy tans, and grays. The style is reminiscent of Jacques-Louis David.

artworks.title: An Elegant Young Man Personifying Vanity
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Diane Allen Nixon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with a figure holding an object. The drawing depicts a figure sitting in a pastoral landscape, holding what appears to be a mirror or a feather. The scene is drawn in a loose, sketch-like manner. The figure is clad in draped garments, set against a backdrop of trees and a faint suggestion of distant fields or hills. The foreground includes a bird with its plumage fanned out. The lines and shading are executed with a brisk and energetic hand.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape with an Obelisk
artworks.creditLine: Rudolf and Lore Heinemann Fund
artworks.description: The painting features a landscape view from an elevated perspective, showcasing lush vegetation and rolling hills in the distance. An obelisk-like structure is seen on the right side. The brushwork is varied, with detailed strokes for the trees and foliage, and blended strokes for the sky. The color palette is dominated by earthy greens, browns, blues, and whites. A path with figures and animals leads through the scene, transitioning into a softer focus towards the hill with the obelisk.

artworks.title: Joshua Commanding the Sun to Stand Still
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching in black and brownish black on chine collé [proof]
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 57.1 x 77.8 cm (22 1/2 x 30 5/8 in.)
sheet: 57.6 x 78.8 cm (22 11/16 x 31 in.)
overall (mat size): 66 x 86.4 cm (26 x 34 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund
artworks.description: This grayscale print showcases a landscape with a city or palaces stretching across jagged mountains under a dramatic stormy sky. The buildings are enormous, with huge domes, layers of wide columns, and fortified walls. A huge conflict is occurring in the bottom left corner, with countless people, horses, and some animals that look like elephants. There are rows of tents in the background, in front of a hilly landscape filled with trees. Processions of people stream down the mountains from the large buildings on the right side of the print, some marching and some on horseback, all carrying tall weapons. They head towards the conflict in the bottom left. In the center of the print, towards the bottom, a group of people stand on a rocky ledge overlooking the battle. One person stands with their back to us and one arm outstretched to the sky. A ray of bright light shines on them from a break in the thick, dark clouds. This figure wears a tunic and helmet, and has a shield and sword trapped on their back.

artworks.title: The Superb Lily
artworks.medium: mezzotint with etching on wove paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III and Gregory E. Mescha in honor of Ethne Reuss Clarke
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of multiple lily flowers with distinct, curved petals and speckles. The background features mountains and sky. The color palette consists of sepia tones, emphasizing textures and shadows. The lilies are in the foreground, with their stems and petals extending upward and curling gracefully.

artworks.title: Incantation
artworks.artist: John Dixon after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 61 x 48.6 cm (24 x 19 1/8 in.)
sheet: 61.4 x 48.9 cm (24 3/16 x 19 1/4 in.)
overall (mat size): 86.4 x 66 cm (34 x 26 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund

artworks.title: The Oyster Woman
artworks.artist: Philip Dawe after Henry Robert Morland
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting and focused on opening oysters. She has light-colored hair, delicate facial features, and wears a bonnet tied under her chin. She is dressed in a dark high-collared garment and a striped shawl. In front of her is a barrel of oysters, a lantern, and a bowl on the table. The background is dark, emphasizing the light on the woman's face and work area.

artworks.title: Love in Her Eyes Sits Playing
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after The Reverend Matthew William Peters
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a seated woman. She is positioned facing slightly to her right, with her head tilted gently towards her left shoulder while looking at the viewer. The woman has soft facial features, with a gentle smile and prominent eyes. Her hair is styled in loose curls that frame her face and is adorned with an elaborate hat that features decorative elements like ribbons and possibly feathers. She is wearing a sheer, flowing fabric draped over her shoulders and upper body, and a dress with visible buttons down the front. Around her wrist, she wears a string of beads or pearls. The background is a dark, textured curtain or drape that contrasts with the lighter tones of her attire and skin.

artworks.title: Amanthis
artworks.medium: mezzotint touched with black and white chalk on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund
artworks.description: The image is of a person's upper body from the side profile. The person is seated or facing right. They have a smooth complexion, defined eyebrows, and looking straight ahead, with curly hair styled elaborately and adorned with a pearl headband. They wear a garment with a high ruffled collar, accessorized with a drop earring. In their hands are a string of pearls and an ornamented pouch. The background is plain in color, highlighting the individual's details.

artworks.title: Amanthis
artworks.medium: mezzotint touched with black ink and white chalk on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body in profile, facing left. The person has delicate facial features with a straight nose, full lips, and wide eyes. Their hair is short and curly with a wide headband. They wear a garment with a lace-trimmed collar and ruffled edges. In their hands, they hold two chains and a small, cloth-wrapped item. The background is a dark gradient.

artworks.title: A Sacrifice to Hymen (Three Daughters of Sir William Montgomery)
artworks.artist: Thomas Watson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.creditLine: Gift of C.G. Boerner
artworks.description: Three women are depicted in different positions. The woman on the left is kneeling, with a hand on a basket of flowers. Her other hand reaches towards the woman in the center. The woman in the center stands angled, looking towards the left, holding a floral garland towards the woman on the right. The woman on the right stands with raised arms. In the background, there is a statue on a pedestal, a lush tree canopy casting shadows, and an open landscape with more trees. An urn with a motif is placed on a pedestal to the far right.

artworks.title: Leopards
artworks.artist: Samuel William Reynolds I after James Northcote
artworks.medium: etching, stipple, and roulette on wove paper [first proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund
artworks.description: In the image, two large cats are depicted in a natural setting. The cats are shown in detailed with their fur patterns and muscular structure. One cat is kneeling with its mouth open, and the other cat is standing with its mouth also open. They are set against a backdrop resembling a cave or rocky area with patches of shaded areas. The drawing is done in a realistic style, showing the movement and expressions of the animals effectively through lines and shading.

artworks.title: Leopards
artworks.artist: Samuel William Reynolds I after James Northcote
artworks.medium: mezzotint with etching, stipple, and roulette touched with white chalk on laid paper [second proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of two leopards in a cave. The leopards are depicted in a dynamic pose with their mouths open. One is crouched low to the ground, while the other stands slightly higher. Their fur is detailed with spots against the cave backdrop. The background shows a cave opening with dim lighting.

artworks.title: Pavillon de Flore, Tuileries
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a grand building on the right. The perspective is from street level, looking towards the building. A streetlamp is on the left. The brushstrokes show detailed architectural elements and figures. The color palette consists of earthy tones for the building and softer shades for the sky. Reds and greens are used in the clothing. The scene depicts a tranquil street from a past era.
